posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
As I think this is going to be my last time near the forums before Christmas I just thought I'd take the opportunity to wish everyone a happy [subject line here]!

 

I also thought I'd try and start a song

In the spirit of sharing I'd be happy to see twelve different forumites responses, you might have two awesome lines but I think it's more fun to see what others can come up with... or they'll be no figgy pudding for anybody

 

On the first day of Sentinel-mas my nemesis sent to meeee

A cohort in an MDP

 

(Yes, I am anal enough to come back a week later and edit this post to correct a spelling mistake)
